parsed.rationale: Both `MockHLSAVPlayer.play` and `MockPlayer.play` live under test-support paths (`Shared/Playback/Tests/HLSPlayerTests/` and `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/`) within the `Playback` package. Although the context flags report `is_test: false` and `is_mock: false`, the file paths and type names (prefixed `Mock`) make clear these are test-double types. The two mocks exist to satisfy different protocol conformances (`HLSAVPlayer` vs a more general `Player` interface), so the structural coincidence of a no-body or trivially-identical `play()` stub is expected and intentional. Consolidating them would couple unrelated mock hierarchies and risk breaking test isolation.
